teaser.en: A forest liana whose bright red pods split open to show black seeds.

summary.en: Mtsophe is Agelaea pentagyna, a woody climber of forest and thicket. Pakia records only its Digo name.

about.en: Mtsophe is a woody climber or scrambling shrub. Its leaves are divided into three leaflets, the side ones lopsided. It bears sprays of small white, fragrant flowers, followed by small, hairy, red to orange pods that split along one side to show a black seed partly wrapped in a fleshy aril.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and riverine thicket across tropical Africa and Madagascar, including the coastal forests of Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsophe but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Agelaea pentagyna.

reason.en: Rourea, another climber of the same family
